children.name: Gameplane/Page Header
texts: Platform-wide configuration for this Gameplane instance.

children.name: text
children.text: Built-in local accounts plus federated identity providers. Changes take effect on save — no restart needed.

children.name: text
children.text: At least one identity provider must stay enabled — the last enabled provider can't be turned off.

children.name: text
children.text: Rules are checked top to bottom. The first group the user belongs to decides their role.

children.name: text
children.text: This group is already matched by rule 1, so this rule never applies.

children.name: text
children.text: Used when no rule matches. Users whose role was set by hand are always let in.

children.name: cardSubtitle
children.text: Read-only snapshot of the identity provider configured via api.oidc.* Helm values at install time. Connection settings are not editable here; the role rules can be overridden below.

children.name: oidcHeaderHint
children.text: Groups claim, rules and fallback come from the same Helm values and are not editable here.

children.name: Description
children.text: Rule 1 above grants admin through Helm values, not the dashboard, so there is no confirmation step here. Verify the group contains only trusted accounts — anyone in it gets full admin access.

children.name: cardSubtitle
children.text: Overrides the whole Helm rule list and fallback. A change takes effect the next time an affected user signs in — no restart or reinstall needed.

children.name: text
children.text: Rules are checked top to bottom. The first group the user belongs to decides their role.
